stem: Why are the woman's comments about the nest in paragraphs 6 through 10 important to the story?

options.label: A
options.text: They explain why it is problematic that the turtles are hatching early.

options.label: B
options.text: They establish that the woman is knowledgeable about the life cycle of turtles.

options.label: C
options.text: They reveal the significance of seeing the turtles hatch from their nest.

options.label: D
options.text: They show that the local residents think tourists disregard the safety of the turtles.
